in_marathi.name: Nageshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Serpents
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nageshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nageshwar is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Lord of Serpents'. It is a revered name in Hindu mythology, associated with Lord Shiva who is often depicted with serpents as his companions or adornments.
